import sys
import unittest

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, '/source')
from app import balance_after_payment, checkout

class SmokeDefensor(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reembolso_aumenta_saldo(self):
        self.assertEqual(balance_after_payment(100, -20), 120)

    def test_pagamento_positivo_e_zero(self):
        self.assertEqual(balance_after_payment(100, 20), 80)
        self.assertEqual(balance_after_payment(100, 0), 100)

    def test_checkout_rejeita_negativo_e_texto(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            checkout(-10)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            checkout('100')

    def test_checkout_desconta_nao_negativos(self):
        self.assertEqual(checkout(100), 90)
        self.assertEqual(checkout(0), 0)

unittest.main(verbosity=2)
